title: Elimination Game
description: Starting with a list of numbers 1 to n, remove every other number starting from left, then right, alternating directions until one remains.

steps.note: Initialize head at 1, step at 1, and left-to-right flag.
First pass (left to right): remove odd indices (1, 3, 5). Head shifts.
Update n to remaining count (3), double the step (4).
Second pass (right to left): n is odd, head shifts.
